request.query: Modal lowers H100 GPU price to $3.95 per hour

results.title: NVIDIA H100 pricing: rental rates and total cost | Hivenet
highlights:
NVIDIA H100 pricing depends on the GPU variant, the number of GPUs you rent, and what the service includes. On October 19, 2026, Lambda listed a single H100 PCIe instance at $3.29 per GPU-hour and a single H100 SXM instance at $4.29. Modal listed H100 SXM5 GPU time at $0.001097 per second, approximately $3.95 per hour, with other resources charged separately. The provider links and billing details are in the comparison below.

These are dated examples, not a market-wide minimum or a guarantee of available capacity. A useful comparison starts with the complete bill for a workload

...

If a provider quotes the whole instance, multiply that instance rate by time once. Multiplying it by the GPU count again would double-count the hardware.

...

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lambda: 1× H100 PCIe, 80 GB | $3.29 | Per GPU-hour; one-GPU instance | Bundled host resources, storage, tax, capacity |
| Lambda: 1× H100 SXM, 80 GB | $4.29 | Per GPU-hour; one-GPU instance | Exact configuration and availability |
| Lambda: 8× H100 SXM, 80 GB each | $3.99 per GPU; $31.92 for eight | Per hour; full instance has eight GPUs | Budget for the whole instance |
| Runpod Pods: H100 PCIe, 80 GB | $2.89 | Listed hourly rate per GPU | Deployment quote, region, host resources, storage, taxes |
| Runpod Pods: H100 SXM, 80 GB | $3.99 | Listed hourly rate per GPU | Deployment quote and available configuration |
| Runpod Pods: H100 NVL, 94 GB | $3.19 | Listed hourly rate per GPU | GPU count and interconnect; not a quote for a two-GPU pair |
| Modal: H100 SXM5 GPU tasks | $0.001097/second, about $3.95/hour | GPU component only | CPU, memory, storage, egress, plan and execution options |

Lambda describes minute-based billing and lists applicable taxes separately. Its eight-GPU rate should not be presented as the price of a single-GPU rental. Modal's hourly figure above is a conversion of its published per-second GPU rate, not an all-inclusive instance quote.

results.title: Cloud GPU providers ranked by H100 price, Sep 2026
highlights:
- Ranked by lowest listed on-demand H100 price per GPU-hour, checked 28 September 2026: RunPod $2.89, Lambda $3.29, Nebius $3.85, Crusoe $3.90, Modal $3.95, Together AI $3.99, DigitalOcean $4.41, CoreWeave $6.16.
- The top two prices are for H100 PCIe. Among the other H100 listings, RunPod’s H100 SXM at $3.49 is still the cheapest. 1 
- Billing units differ. Modal and DigitalOcean bill by the second, Lambda by the minute, Crusoe and Together AI by the hour, and CoreWeave prices a whole 8-GPU node. 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 3

- The order moves on 1 October 2026, when Nebius lists $4.50 and drops from third to seventh. 9
